description: Sylvan Slough, the channel south of Arsenal Island between Moline and Rock Island, is closed at its head by the low Sylvan Island (Moline) dam; boats pass Rock Island only through Lock 15. OSM maps no dam there, so the slough's water area gave a way round Lock and Dam 15 with no lock. Source: https://www.mvr.usace.army.mil/Missions/Navigation/Locks-and-Dams/Locks-and-Dam-15/
